patch_description: This crossover keeps the stronger behavior of the current program: pivot-based weight reconstruction and outputting the final simulated-annealing state rather than the surrogate-optimal saved state. It incorporates practical implementation improvements: fixed-size comparison caches instead of maps, iterative merge sorting, O(1) pivot membership lookup, direct query printing, and a compact assignment optimizer. These reduce overhead and leave more reliable time for annealing while preserving the required exactly-Q interactive protocol.
